record.content: Signed STF-16-2026-09 page 1, effective July 31, 2026–July 30, 2029: Undeveloped-location camping within one Ranger District is limited to 21 total days during a calendar year. Exemptions: FS-7700-48 permits specifically exempting the holder, and official-duty officers or organized rescue/fire personnel.
